summary: Completed API and browser testing for admin and driver authentication, dashboard, navigation, delivery status updates, inventory, finance, customers, and mobile layout.
action_items: Review CORS configuration: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid/insecure for credentialed browser requests; use explicit configured origins.
Enforce role authorization on administrative endpoints if drivers should not access dashboard, product, delivery, and expense management APIs.
Make startup seeding idempotently synchronize seeded passwords when environment credentials change, or document that behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: current_user authenticates users but does not enforce role permissions; driver tokens can call the same admin mutation endpoints.
CORS uses wildcard origins with credentials enabled, which browsers reject for credentialed cross-origin requests and is unsafe as a production policy.
Login returns a JWT in JSON/localStorage; auth_testing.md requests httpOnly cookies, but no access_token cookie is set.
The UI exposes create buttons for delivery, product, expense, and customer, but these buttons have no click behavior or forms.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; delivery d2 status was temporarily changed and restored to in_transit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API tests and Playwright flow passed. Mobile screenshot after opening sidebar shows expected sidebar overlay, though underlying content is partially clipped while menu is open.
rca of the issue: No runtime failures reproduced. Code review findings are preventative: server.py enables wildcard CORS with credentials, omits role checks, and does not issue the httpOnly access_token cookie described by auth_testing.md. App.js renders several primary action buttons without handlers, so those workflows are not implemented despite the buttons appearing interactive.
